title: A failure, a retry, a recovery
summary: A build whose first test run fails: BOSS's own fix round repairs it without a person, and the build still ends completed with a pull request and its gates green. On the scripted engine the failing test is the conformance engine's `failing_test` fault; on an install the sandbox repository's journey-j5 branch carries a failing test the ticket asks to fix.

fixtures: real: a branch (base_branch) whose npm test fails until the bug it describes is fixed

defaults.title: Fix the slug bug the failing test shows
defaults.instructions: npm test fails: slug() must lowercase and join words with hyphens. Make the failing test pass without weakening it.
criteria: slug lowercases and joins words with hyphens

vars.title: Slug service (a test fails first)
vars.instructions: Build a tiny plain Node ESM service at the repository root: slug(text) in src/slug.js and an HTTP server in src/server.js answering GET /?q=<text> with {"slug": ...} on $PORT. Tests under node --test.
criteria: slug lowercases and joins words with hyphens
GET /?q= answers the slug as JSON

acceptance.text: BOSS ran a fix round on its own
The tests passed after the fix round
The build recovered and finished as completed
A pull request was opened after the repair
The old tests still pass on the final gate
BOSS's acceptance check found every must-have met
